title: President Ramaphosa visits Sasol Secunda, highlights its contribution to South Africa’s industrial capability
summary: Secunda, South Africa – Sasol today hosted President Cyril Ramaphosa at its Secunda Operations, where he acknowledged the company’s role in South Africa’s economy, industrial capability and job creation. Led by Sasol President and Chief Executive Officer Simon Baloyi, the visit showcased the scale and integration of the Secunda operations, and its role in supporting energy security, industrial development and economic growth.
body_markdown:
# Overview


Through proprietary technologies and processes the main products Sasol produces are fuel components, chemical components and co-products. From these main products and further value-adding processes we deliver diesel, petrol (gasoline), naphtha, kerosene (jet fuel), liquid petroleum gas (LPG), olefins, alcohols, polymers, solvents, surfactants, co-monomers, ammonia, methanol, crude tar acids, sulphur, illuminating paraffin, bitumen and fuel oil. Even further processing produces numerous additional products.
